description: This file provides centralized date/time formatting utilities, including functions to validate timezones, format timestamps in UTC, and format timestamps with timezone display, using Intl.DateTimeFormat.

methods.name: resolveTimezone
methods.description: Validates an IANA timezone string, returning the string if valid, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: formatUtcTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a Date object as a UTC timestamp string, optionally including seconds.

methods.name: formatZonedTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a Date object with timezone display using Intl.DateTimeFormat, optionally including seconds.
